{{Quote|I have Arakyd EJ-25 concussion rifles, still in factory package! Not cheap knockoffs&mdash;finest quality!|Nurkolas|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''EJ-25 concussion rifle''' was a type of rifle produced by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Nurkolas]], owner of [[Nurkolas Arms]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], had a shipment of factory-new EJ-25 rifles for sale.
